intro.title1: PLB Reformas Premium: interior architecture and renovations with soul.
intro.col1: At PLB Obras y Reformas Premium S.L., we transform residential and commercial properties with uncompromising quality, rigorous commitment, and expert technical direction. Backed by more than 15 years of proven experience across the Valencian Community, we guide every stage of your project to provide absolute peace of mind and an all-inclusive turnkey service from initial concept to key handover.
intro.col2: Every exceptional space begins by listening closely to your lifestyle. We never just execute construction work: our team meticulously coordinates every trade, harmonizing architectural layout, interior design, and flawless finishes to transform your vision into an elegant, functional sanctuary with genuine identity.
intro.title2: Architecture and 3D Design: Visualize before you build.
intro.desc2: Our in-house architectural department develops precise custom plans and photorealistic 3D renderings. You can explore layout alternatives, lighting scenes, and select exact textures and finishes before construction begins, ensuring perfection in every detail.

about.title: A comprehensive approach to creating spaces you truly love living in
about.desc: We unite all phases of your renovation under a single technical management, from initial consultation to the final finish. With our own dedicated team and no impersonal subcontractors, we take full responsibility for every millimeter executed.
about.quote: A renovation is not just taking down walls and laying cables: it is conceiving a bright, balanced, and comfortable space where your family enjoys exceptional quality of life.

process.title: A clear process, no surprises
process.subtitle: Structured and transparent, so you can enjoy your renovation with total peace of mind.

steps.title: Consultation & assessment
steps.desc: We visit your home or business, listen to your ideas, and measure at no cost.
steps.seoDesc: We visit your property anywhere in the Valencian Community. We inspect structural conditions, listen to your desires, and take accurate laser measurements free of charge.

steps.title: Fixed-price quote
steps.desc: Itemized proposal line by line. What is signed in contract is exactly what you pay.
steps.seoDesc: We draft a comprehensive technical proposal itemized trade by trade with fixed prices and certified material grades. What you sign is exactly what you pay.

steps.title: Execution & site management
steps.desc: A dedicated project director coordinates the trades and oversees quality and deadlines.
steps.seoDesc: A dedicated project manager oversees our technical specialists. Continuous supervision, rigorous quality control, and strict compliance with the agreed schedule.

steps.title: Handover & warranty
steps.desc: We review every detail with you, clean the site thoroughly, and issue a 2-year written warranty.
steps.seoDesc: We inspect every finish with you down to the last detail. We perform an exhaustive post-construction deep clean and deliver your written 2-year warranty.

testimonials.title: Verified Client Reviews
testimonials.subtitle: Over 85% of our new projects in the Valencian Community originate from direct recommendations by satisfied homeowners.

reviews.author: Gómez R. Family
reviews.quote: We completely renovated our beachfront apartment. They delivered the keys on the exact day agreed, the quote did not deviate by a single euro, and the architectural LED lighting and drywall work transformed the space completely. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Elena & Marcus V.
reviews.quote: The kitchen turned out exactly as we dreamed. They guided us on every detail regarding flow, stone worktops, and hidden joinery. The strict adherence to deadlines and the team's professionalism gave us complete peace of mind, leaving everything spotless.

reviews.author: David M.
reviews.quote: Outstanding professionalism and discipline. The site manager was constantly available to coordinate the trades. They took immense care of the building common areas and the contractual warranty provides total peace of mind.
